author: Okkerka
description: Information, polls, random choices, timestamps, private quotes and persistent personal reminders, with prefix and slash commands.
install_msg: Utilities loaded. See `[p]help Utilities` and this cog's README for commands and slash setup. Thanos is prefix-only.
name: Utilities
end_user_data_statement: Stores configured Hawk user IDs per server and up to 20 personal reminders per user, including text, due times and delivery status. Delivered reminders are removed; failed reminders remain until cancelled or user data is deleted.
